product.name: Monoprice 3-Pin XLR Female Mic Connector Gold Plated Pins
product.description: Make your own custom length XLR cables using this 3-Pin XLR Female Connector from Monoprice!                    This 3-pin female connector features a nickel-tin body, gold plated pins for smooth, corrosion-free connections, and a rubber strain relief boot. Use this with our bulk microphone cable to make custom XLR cables.                    Note: For custom DMX512 cables, use PID 601652 3-pin Female DMX Connector and PID 601660 2-Conductor DMX Lighting & AES/EBU Bulk Cable instead.
